generated.title: M6.0 Earthquake Strikes Near Vanuatu | Next Huge Quake #shorts
generated.description:
A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck 186 km northwest of Port-Olry, Vanuatu, on October 19, 2026 at 07:49 UTC, at a depth of 10 km, according to the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS).

The earthquake occurred within a sequence of earthquakes near Vanuatu; USGS also recorded two magnitude 5.7 earthquakes in the area later the same day.

USGS issued a green PAGER alert, its lowest level, a modeled estimate of low potential fatalities and economic losses. No tsunami was flagged in the USGS data.

Event page: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us6000u3bc
